Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1392
Claimant:
Jaclyn Watson
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2 Aug 2024
First notice of loss received for a low-speed collision in a parking lot. The insured reports that another vehicle backed
into the rear of their car while it was parked, and the claimant was seated inside at the time.
26 Oct 2024
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that coverage was in force when the incident occurred. Nothing
in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
6 Nov 2024
Obtained the police report and two witness statements, which describe the collision the same way the insured did.
Photos taken at the scene show the damage is consistent with the reported impact, and the other driver has also
confirmed the account.
13 Nov 2024
Reviewed the vehicle damage estimate. The rear bumper, tailgate and taillight damage lines up with the described
point of impact, and no prior damage to the vehicle is on record.
21 Nov 2024
Claimant's counsel submitted a demand reporting neck and back strain. The claimant has given the same account of
the accident in every conversation so far, and the police and witnesses confirm they were in the vehicle at the time.
1 Dec 2024
Medical records show treatment following a typical course for soft tissue strain, with care tapering as the claimant
improved. No prior injury to the neck or back is known, and the reported injury is plausible for a collisoin of this type.
16 Mar 2025
Reviewed the file with supervisor. Liability and coverage are confirmed, the injury is consistent with the mechanism of
the collision, and the claim is moving forward for evaluation of the bodily injury portion.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
